en: The Questions of King Milinda, Chapter on Investigation: 14.
The Question on the Characteristic of Investigation (Vicāra)
“Venerable Nāgasena, what is the characteristic of sustained thought (vicāra)?
“It has the characteristic of continuous stroking, Great King, that is sustained thought.
“Just as, great king, when a bronze gong is struck it reverberates and continues to vibrate afterwards, so, great king, should initial application of thought (vitakka) be regarded as the striking,
and sustained application of thought (vicāra) as the reverberation.
“You are skillful, venerable Nāgasena,” he said.
The fourteenth question: on the characteristic of sustained application (*vicāra*).
This is the third chapter on sustained application.
There are fourteen questions in this chapter.
